name: Creatine monohydrate

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A nitrogenous organic acid that buffers ATP resynthesis through the phosphocreatine system. Among the most extensively studied ergogenic dietary supplements, with consistent effects on high-intensity performance and lean mass.

systems.note: Increased intramuscular phosphocreatine supporting high-intensity work and lean mass; the intended effect.
Cognitive effect under sleep deprivation and stress is a secondary studied effect.
Raises serum creatinine by substrate loading without reducing filtration; the creatinine-based eGFR reads falsely low.

monitors.why: Rises on creatine loading without a true fall in filtration; this is the classic false-alarm on the board.
Filtration marker unaffected by creatine loading; the value that settles the question.
The filtration estimate that survives creatine supplementation.
The effect the supplement is taken for.
